scientific.integrity: The exact 2009 problem statement and the closest primary optimal-isometry paper were materially inspected. The archive date is supported by the Polish National Bibliography issue dated 10--16 May 2009 listing the volume. The new spherical moments and implicit-function coefficient are derived analytically and replayed symbolically from the packaged checker.
limitations: The theorem covers finite p>2, not the Hausdorff endpoint, whose nonexistence result is prior.
The general-dimensional perturbation size is only required to be sufficiently small and is not optimized.
Historical novelty retains a residual risk from later unindexed literature.
